name: costmaxx
description: Codex efficiency layer with observe-only lifecycle hooks and an opt-in costmax_run MCP tool that reduces large command results while storing retrievable evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Reduce verbose command output with retrievable evidence.
interface.longDescription: CostMax is a local-first, opt-in MCP tool that returns compact summaries for verbose commands while keeping the complete output retrievable by digest. Codex lifecycle hooks are observe-only.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use CostMax for a verbose local command and keep the full evidence retrievable.
